text: maria: quick sync — did the design review notes land in the console repo about the in-product docs panel? i'm worried the copy and link targets are still out of sync with docs.redwood.ai :thinking_face: aj: i pushed a tiny update to the panel copy yesterday, but it was using the old term 'model alias' instead of 'model tag' — noticed while testing keyboard nav amaria: ugh, that mismatch is the root cause. customers keep searching for 'tag' in docs and the console says 'alias' samir: tossing in an accessibility nit: the docs panel header doesn't have an aria-describedby pointing to the link list. screen readers read the panel as "dialog" with no landmarks. olivia: good catch. i also saw contrast issues on the grey link hover state — fails AA at 14px. i'll attach a screenshot in the PR. :camera: pm-jen: thanks. key items i heard so far: (1) terminolgy canonicalization ('model tag' vs 'model alias'), (2) ensure cross-links from console to canonical docs, (3) in-product panel accessibility fixes and keyboard focus order, (4) small copy edits for clarity. correct? maria: yes. also want two-way linking: the docs article for "Deploying models" should link back to the console route (Console → Models → ). otherwise it's hard for enterprise folks to find the UI. aj: agree. i sketched a tiny config block for the docs team to use when adding console links. sample: ```html Open in Console ``` aj: adding `data-console-link` helps us catch them during builds and validate the target route. samir: for screen readers we should ensure the anchor has `aria-label="Open model in Console, model name: {{name}}"` so context isn't lost. olivia: i've updated the design tokens so hover color is #0b5fff now — passes contrast at 14px. will push in a separate PR so devs can pick it up independently. pm-jen: who owns merging the console copy changes? maria? maria: i can own the copy changes and the link targets. can someone from eng-runtime add the aria attributes and focus trap fix? aj: i can take the focus order/focus-visible fixes. samir — can you validate with VoiceOver/JAWS? samir: yep, i'll run a quick pass and leave notes. won't be a long block. design-bot: Reminder: design review checklist incomplete: docs cross-links, keyboard nav, contrast, aria labels. Please add PR links to the checklist by EOD. maria: action items: (1) maria — canonicalize lexicon and update panel copy + add doc links (2) aj — keyboard/focus fixes (3) samir — accessibility validation (4) olivia — token/hover color PR (5) docs team — add reciprocal console links for deploy/run articles. i'll post the canonical term in #product-glossary right after this thread. aj: timeline? aiming to land before next sprint planning (5 working days). pm-jen: sounds reasonable. if anyone hits enterprise legal copy requirements, flag me and i'll triage. maria: thanks all. i'll open the copy PR now and paste link here when ready. :rocket:
